packageRules.description: Tauri, its plugins and its build crates move together, Rust and npm sides alike; reviewed by hand

specta, specta-typescript and tauri-specta are release candidates pinned with = that require each other's exact versions (tauri-specta rc.29 needs specta =rc.28 and specta-typescript 0.0.15): one PR, reviewed by hand. After the tauri rule, which tauri-specta also matches.
The SHA-pinned actions of the workflows, once a month, reviewed by hand: release.yml (signing, provenance, artifacts) runs only nightly and on tags, so a pull request's checks do not cover it
schedule: before 7am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Held back: 0.28+ is on html5ever 0.40, a second HTML engine next to wry's dom_query 0.28 (html5ever 0.39); cargo-deny fails it. Lift once wry is on dom_query 0.29.
Held back with scraper: nowplaying uses ego-tree's NodeId on scraper's trees, so both must use the same ego-tree (0.11 for scraper 0.27). Lift together with scraper.
Held back: zbus 6 would sit next to zbus 5, which souvlaki, ksni and the Tauri plugins (opener, single-instance) still use. notify-rust 4.19 moved to zbus 6. Lift both once they are all on zbus 6.
Held back with zbus, see above
Held back: gtk and webkit2gtk are the versions Tauri (wry, tao, muda) already pulls in; a newer one would put a second GTK binding in the tree. Lift once Tauri moves.
Held back with gtk, see above
Held back: the Rust job runs on Ubuntu 22.04 on purpose, the system the .deb is built on (release.yml), for the same system libraries
Held back: TypeScript only serves svelte-check, whose peer range stops at ^6 (TS 7 is the Go rewrite, with a new API). Lift once svelte-check accepts TS 7.
